Star the repository to find it again and help more developers discover it.</p></div><a class="projects-radar-link" href="https://github.com/jevaidev/jev-ai-radar" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-radar-placement="projects-directory"><svg class="" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2.7 2.84 5.76 6.36.92-4.6 4.49 1.09 6.33L12 17.21 6.31 20.2l1.09-6.33-4.6-4.49 6.36-.92L12 2.7Z"></path></svg> <!-- -->Star Jev AI Radar on GitHub<!-- --> <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></aside><section class="projects-system-one" id="open-decision-models" aria-labelledby="projects-system-one-title"><div class="projects-section-heading"><div><span class="projects-kicker">System One</span><h2 id="projects-system-one-title">Community System One ecosystem.</h2></div><div class="projects-system-one-summary"><p>These community models and interface experiments are inspired by Jev or explore similar structured-decision approaches. They are not official TypeSafe Jev releases and are kept separate from the GitHub project ranking above.</p><a class="projects-system-one-guide" href="/system-one/">Read the System One developer guide<!-- --> <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></div></div><div class="projects-system-one-grid"><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-nimble"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3.5-9B</code></div><h3>Bespoke Nimble</h3><p>A Jev-inspired LoRA adapter and training recipe for typed choices and yes/no decisions. Runs locally; text input only.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/bespokelabsai/nimble" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-nanojev"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3-0.6B</code></div><h3>NanoJev</h3><p>A small model with decision heads, published training code, and game demos for testing action choices.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/TianyuCodings/NanoJev" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-decider"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3.5-2B</code></div><h3>decider</h3><p>A fine-tuned model that returns distributions for typed questions in one pass. Its current release supports English.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/Mapika/decider" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-verdict"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>ModernBERT 151M / Verdict 2.0</code></div><h3>Verdict</h3><p>A small encoder-based decision model with published weights and an in-browser WebGPU demo.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/Heman10x-NGU/openJev-verdict-2.0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-dohnuts"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3.5-0.8B</code></div><h3>Dohnuts</h3><p>A 0.8B multimodal decision model with published weights, training code, and evaluations. It handles text and images in one forward pass; its weights are for non-commercial research.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/PsiACE/dohnuts" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-openjev"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B</code></div><h3>OpenJev</h3><p>Uses the existing DiffusionGemma model to answer structured questions through a Jev-like API. It does not publish new model weights.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/razorback16/openjev" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-simple"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>Open-model logits</code></div><h3>Simple Jev</h3><p>Uses existing open models to score allowed answers through a Jev-like interface. It does not publish new model weights.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/featherless-ai/simple-jev" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-rizzo"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>Spark-X2.5-4B</code></div><h3>Rizzo Flow</h3><p>A local Jev-compatible server that reads answer logits from Spark-X2.5 models. Questions share one state prefill, and the project includes a playground and benchmarks.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/Rizzo-AI-Academy/rizzo-flow" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-anyjev"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>Any causal LLM</code></div><h3><a href="/anyjev/" hrefLang="en">AnyJev</a></h3><p>A training-free toolkit that turns causal language models into typed decision models, with option-order debiasing, optional calibration, and reproducible benchmarks.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="/anyjev/" hrefLang="en">AnyJev guide <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a><a href="https://github.com/nokia-applied-research/AnyJev" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-localjev"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>Qwen3.5 / DeBERTa</code></div><h3>local-jev</h3><p>An offline Jev-compatible server for Qwen or DeBERTa models, tested with the official SDK and accompanied by published JevBench results.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/amithgc/local-jev" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-agentjev"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3-0.6B</code></div><h3>AgentJev</h3><p>A Qwen3-0.6B decision model for agent traces and other structured questions, with published weights, a typed HTTP API and no token decoding.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/malevrigns/agent-jev" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-llm2jev"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>Causal LMs / SGLang</code></div><h3>LLM2Jev</h3><p>Adapts local causal language models into Jev-compatible Choice, Score and Noul services through prefill-only scoring, with SGLang, Transformers and multimodal support.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/Yinsongxu/LLM2Jev" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-laya"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>Laya / ONNX Runtime</code></div><h3>Laya</h3><p>Runs the open Laya System One model from Node.js through ONNX Runtime, using a Jev-compatible request shape and published model weights.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/receptron/laya" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-openthai"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3.5-0.8B</code></div><h3>OpenThai System One</h3><p>A Qwen3.5-0.8B Thai-and-English decision model with published weights, training code and a Jev-compatible HTTP API.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/iapp-technology/openthai-systemone" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-valen"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3.5-0.8B / 2B</code></div><h3>Valen</h3><p>A multimodal decision model inspired by Jev that accepts text, images and video, with published weights, training code and evaluation commands.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/Liuziyu77/Valen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-tev1"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Community model</span><code>Qwen3.5-4B</code></div><h3>Tev1</h3><p>An open 4B decision model fine-tuned from Qwen3.5, with model weights, a reproducible training recipe and documented data provenance.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/togethercomputer/tev1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article><article class="projects-system-one-card" id="model-ollaya"><div class="projects-system-one-card-top"><span>Interface experiment</span><code>Open decision models</code></div><h3>Ollaya</h3><p>A local Rust service that downloads and runs several open decision models behind native and TypeSafe-compatible APIs.</p><div class="projects-system-one-card-links"><a href="https://github.com/ollaya-dev/ollaya" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></article></div><p class="projects-system-one-note">Independent community work, not official Jev releases.</p></section><section class="projects-submit" id="submit-project" aria-labelledby="submit-project-title"><div class="projects-submit-intro"><span class="projects-kicker">Built with
